author: Carolyn Baker
text: We have used CTC for both water well servicing and septic pumping.  The office staff is first class.  We recently have a water service tech out and he was able to easily diagnose our issue and resolve it.  Had septic tanks pumped in 2025 and will be having them done again soon.  Great service always!

author: Michael Edinburgh
text:
Coast to Coast service rep, Brian, is a very polite, efficient, and hard working young man.  He found a the problem with my aerobic septic pump and in short order had it replaced and functioning as designed.  Pricing was very reasonable for the amount of time spent and materials used to replace the pump and a broken sprinkler head.
Will gladly refer this septic service to all my neighbors in Montgomery!

author: JBE JBE
text: The septic alarm was blaring so I called Coast to Coast.  They arrived within 2 hours and quickly diagnosed the evaporator diagram had given up the ghost.  Technician was all business, no friendly chit-chat, but he did explain the issue.  The diaphragm was swiftly replaced and billing was reasonable.

author: Theresa Riggs
text: Noticed a broken pump on Sunday, left a message, and they came out on Monday and repaired.  Staff and operators are very responsive and professional.  We have been using Coast to Coast for Septic and Well maintenance for over 15 years. Highly recommend them.

author: Boë Bowen
text:
Fantastic company. I’ve used them multiple times over the past five years, and they have always delivered.

They kicked butt again today. Even though their office was closed, they still came out on a Sunday and fixed our water for my sick wife.

That level of service and commitment is hard to find. Highly recommend.
